definitionZh: QImg Vue 组件使处理响应式图像变得容易，并且还为其添加了良好的加载效果以及许多其他功能，例如自定义长宽比和标题。
sourceDefinition: The QImg Vue component makes working with responsive images easy and also adds a nice loading effect to them along with many other features like custom aspect ratio and captions.
